question: Where can I find café inside 80 kilometers while progressing from the David C. Driskell Center, College Park, MD toward Montrose Woods Park, Rockville, MD?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%David C. Driskell Center%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Montrose Woods Park%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 80000 -- 80 kilometers in meters ) );
